title: Topological Winding Readout of an Emergent Page-Wootters Clock
summary: The Page--Wootters construction gives time a Hilbert space, representing it as an internal degree of freedom whose readings the rest of the system evolves with respect to. We ask whether such a clock degree of freedom can carry a topological invariant, and we propose a photonic architecture in which it does and in which the invariant can be measured.
